Smart and versatile men’s cotton pants featuring a clean straight-leg silhouette, structured waistband and classic casual styling. Designed to deliver a polished appearance with everyday comfort, making them an excellent choice for casual, office, travel and smart-casual wear.

Upgrade your everyday wardrobe with these men’s classic cotton casual pants. The clean straight-fit construction provides a balanced and comfortable silhouette from waist to hem. A smooth cotton fabric appearance gives the pants a refined alternative to traditional denim jeans. The waistband features practical belt loops with a secure button and fly-front fastening. Functional pocket construction adds everyday convenience while maintaining a neat appearance. Clean tonal stitching complements the fabric and creates a sophisticated, understated finish. Easy to coordinate with polo shirts, T-shirts, casual shirts, sweaters and jackets. A versatile choice for office-casual dressing, outings, travelling, gatherings and daily wear.
